assetCredits: Palace east, Main Guard south and Parliament south lower-wing facade charts: original project artwork, CC0-1.0. Reference-only photographs: Matti Porre / Office of the President; Finnish Heritage Agency via Finna; Volker von Bonin / Finnish Heritage Agency via Yle; Helsinki City Museum; Lev Karavanov / Mostphotos via Parliament. No reference-photo pixels are shipped.
Characters derived from Snow and Rain © Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0, modified
Finn player: user modification of Snow by Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0; supplied native rig and movement clips
Finn movement generated in the supplied project with NVIDIA Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.2, selected, looped and retargeted by the project owner; gameplay poses adapted for Helsinki
Rain officer: supplied Poliisi-uniform adaptation of Rain by Blender Studio, CC BY 4.0; eleven native movement clips retained, gameplay actions and uniform correction by Helsinki project
Vehicle derived from the project owner's rigged car model, brand marks removed
Helsinki Cathedral: low-poly model supplied by the project owner, placed on the city model and light-baked
Tree models and their textures generated procedurally for the project (tools/blender/build_tree_models.py)
Alexander II monument: improved model supplied by the project owner; calibrated to 10.67 m, placed at Senate Square centre and texture-compressed. Source sculpture limitations retained.
Parliament front: original procedural facade authoring fitted to the City of Helsinki model; architectural references used for proportions only, without embedded reference pixels.
Finlandia Hall facade: bounded restoration using City of Helsinki CC BY 4.0 texture pixels and authored details; architectural photographs and drawings used as visual references only.

Street paving footprints and source material classifications: City of Helsinki public area register, CC BY 4.0. Tram track axes: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Paving and rail artwork are original procedural CC0-1.0 assets; no Google imagery is shipped.
